cand.title: XXIV Annual Workshop on Soft-Collinear Effective Theory (SCET 2027)
cand.excerpt: Strong evidence of a dated organized programme and a plausible airport-corridor lodging/meeting/catering mechanism, discounted where venue/hotel is committed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Gherardo Vita and Philipp Böer are verified SCET 2027 chairpersons and CERN theoretical-physics contacts. They are relevant organizer introductions for lodging needs and administrative routing, not verified hotel-contract buyers. Published work emails: gherardo.vita@cern.ch and philipp.boeer@cern.ch. Other announced chairs: Patrick Angus Hager and Rebecca von Kuk. Operational route: TH secretariat, thworkshops.secretariat@cern.ch. CERN Housing handles the separately evidenced Panorama hostel reservations; no named housing contracting officer was established.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced upcoming edition: 22–25 March 2027, 09:00 start / 19:00 finish, Europe/Zurich, at CERN. These are activity dates, not the department page submission timestamp. Within the requested horizon. Separate SCET Panorama Lectures run 17–19 March 2027; do not merge them into the workshop dates. No official 2028 edition was located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specification: a conditional lodging / breakfast and possibly separately requested dinner opportunity, not a meeting relocation. YOTEL is in Founex, Vaud, while sessions are on the Meyrin CERN campus. The hotel advertises an airport shuttle, not a CERN shuttle; daily campus transfers, access-card arrangements and total cost require agreement. Neither a resort retreat nor downtown Geneva convention-housing thesis is supported. Published 2027 attendance is absent, so neither too-large nor too-small can be established; the historical 80-person cap in 2024 is not a 2027 forecast. Do not convert the hotel’s 20–120-room commercial band into event demand, or assume a 237-room buyout.
findings.venueCommitments: CERN, 4/3-006 – TH Conference Room, Building 4, third floor, Meyrin, canton of Geneva, Switzerland. This is the Meyrin / Geneva Airport-side CERN campus, not Geneva city centre, Founex/Nyon/La Côte, or Lausanne. Published meeting location is committed; no signed venue contract was inspected. It is not a competing commercial hotel.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified recent sequence: XXI, Salamanca, Spain, 15–18 April 2024, Colegio Arzobispo Fonseca, Salón de Actos; XXII, Tucson, USA, 10–13 March 2025, University of Arizona PAS building, room 201; XXIII, Seoul, Republic of Korea, 2–5 March 2026, KIAS, Building 1, fifth floor, room 1503; XXIV, CERN/Meyrin, Switzerland, 22–25 March 2027. Consecutive annual editions and international destination rotation are verified. Annual recurrence does not establish an annual CERN return or a 2028 local opportunity.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Main workshop, 22–25 March: sourcing unconfirmed. No workshop-specific hotel list, room block, external housing bureau or open RFP was located; do not retain the seed status open_or_unannounced as evidence of availability. Important separate-programme evidence: the Panorama Lectures accommodation page says participants "need to make their own arrangements for their accommodation (either at the CERN hostel or hotels nearby)" and "a number of rooms at the CERN Hostel have been blocked for this conference." Its booking form is explicitly for "SCET Panorama Lectures School 2027" and "From 16th to 20 March 2027"; it does NOT establish a block for 22–25 March. Requests go to housing.service@cern.ch at least 31 days before expected arrival, subject to availability. CERN Hostel is the only accommodation property named on that precursor page; an external general local-hotel directory is linked, not an edition-specific commitment. No named commercial hotel is verified for the main 2027 workshop.
findings.organizationStructure: CERN is an intergovernmental research organization headquartered in Meyrin; this is a Department of Theoretical Physics scientific workshop supported by the TH secretariat, not a scaling company. No association legal owner, external PCO, DMC or commercial event agency is identified in the reviewed edition material. The workshop organizers, CERN meeting venue and Housing Service are distinct roles; procurement authority remains unverified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Main scientific venue is already CERN. The preceding Lectures have a real CERN Hostel block, but no quantity or sell-out evidence; its booking form offers single room with bathroom at CHF 62 per night and single room with washbasin at CHF 29, which is a relevant budget benchmark only for that programme. This suggests price/convenience pressure on off-site lodging, not a verified workshop incumbent or overflow requirement. No source establishes displaced demand, insufficient hostel capacity, or any commercial-hotel commitment for the main workshop.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First contact thworkshops.secretariat@cern.ch, with Gherardo Vita or Philipp Böer as named organizer routes. Ask whether a separate 22–25 March workshop hostel block exists, who handles off-site accommodation, expected non-local attendees, any unfunded lodging need and whether participants may receive an optional YOTEL rate. Separately ask about delegates attending both programmes; do not assume a continuous stay across 17–25 March. Only if demand is confirmed, propose a small, demand-led lodging/breakfast allocation plus a costed dedicated CERN transfer; agree budget, booking/payment responsibility and release conditions before reserving inventory. Do not pitch replacement plenary space or claim overflow. Deprioritize if CERN lodging fully meets needs or transfer-inclusive pricing is uncompetitive.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of 16 November 2026, the workshop is future and its application is open. Application open means delegate applications, NOT hotel sourcing open. Meeting venue is published at CERN; lodging access is unknown. A permission-based accommodation discussion via the TH secretariat is possible, but no current room allocation or sales eligibility is verified.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: establish a CERN TH accommodation relationship that could support later local workshops, rather than assume SCET 2028 returns to Geneva. International rotation weakens a recurring local SCET room-block thesis. Requalify any later edition only after official city, venue and accommodation arrangements are announced; do not advertise a future CERN edition as confirmed.

historicalEditions.accommodationEvidence: Reserved block at Ramada by Wyndham Tucson, UA rate $103 plus tax for a queen room; quantity not stated. Other named alternatives: Aloft, The Graduate by Hilton, Marriott University Park. Alternatives are recommendations, not additional confirmed blocks. Organizers arranged accommodation for supported graduate students willing to share.

Edition-specific page names KIAS Guest House, Koreana Hotel, New Seoul Hotel, Shilla Stay Gwanghwamun, Aloft Seoul Myeongdong, and 24 Guesthouse Seoul City Hall. Koreana has a KIAS code and special-rate deadline; New Seoul rate is availability-dependent; Shilla Stay uses a discounted-rate form. Do not equate every recommendation with a contracted block, and do not carry these hotels into 2027.
